facts: Settlor conveyed a residential parcel into a trust whose sole present beneficiary is the settlor's daughter. The daughter occupies the home and it is not used for any commercial purpose following the conveyance. The parcel is classified as residential real property under MCL 211.34c. The deed was recorded in March 2026.

expected.notes: 27a(7)(g)(ii) — residential property, sole present beneficiary in the enumerated relative class, no commercial use. Tests the post-2014 branch. [FACTS TIGHTENED 2026-08-04, systematic audit: the statute defines 'residential real property' as property CLASSIFIED as such under section 34c, and the family/trust exceptions in (7)(u), (7)(g)(ii) and (7)(v) all begin 'Beginning December 31, 2014'. Cases that said only 'residential parcel' with no date left the model unable to tell (7)(t) from (7)(u) — which is what made TD-FAMRES-003 fail before it was fixed the same way. Classification and a transfer date are now stated wherever they are load-bearing. The legal question each case tests is unchanged.]
